items.summary: Conditionally approve the howtofry.com preview concept, but do not admit a new implementation request this cycle. The preview must remain isolated, zero-spend, preview-only, unpublished, and non-monetized. Scope may cover cooking-product guide and recipe drafts, visual system, and draft affiliate/social placements using existing repository capabilities only. Do not add dependencies, credentials, tracking, automation, domains, production configuration, or external outreach. The authoritative records conflict on capacity: active_delivery reports 1/10 active slots while performance reports saturation, 13 queued requests, 52 active or measuring improvements, and 29 attention items. Reconcile capacity and release a slot before queue admission. Before any public launch, require the existing site-factory readiness artifact covering owner approval, content scope, analytics and affiliate readiness, legal/compliance, security, measurement, rollback, and preview-only status. No revenue, ROI, margin, or causal-lift claim is supported.

The proposed preview is technically feasible and reversible only as an isolated repository/worktree artifact. Acceptance requires a bounded preview build, deterministic tests, build validation, link/disclosure checks where applicable, an exact diff, and a rollback point. It must not publish, deploy, alter production, enable affiliate or social automation, add telemetry, install dependencies, or consume external services. Preserve the request as planning context until the canonical capacity and repair obligations are resolved.
